verdict.rationale: Porkbun's first-party docs say each API key can be restricted to specific source IPs (CIDR supported) and/or specific domains, so a leaked key can only touch the listed domains from the expected network. Separate sandbox keys (pk1_sb_) and a spend-limit pre-flight check further support least-privilege agent use. missing for 10: action-level permission scopes (e.g., read-only or DNS-only keys) are not documented, nor is any independent or hands-on confirmation that the key restrictions work as claimed.
